svg.title: A nurse is teaching the family of an adult who sleepwalks about home safety. Which measures should the nurse include? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: Clearing hazards, securing exits, sleeping on one level, and alerting the family to movement all reduce the chance of injury during an episode. Waking the client abruptly causes disorientation and agitation, and an open stairway is exactly the hazard the family is trying to remove.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Parasomnia Safety
Read the situation
A nurse is teaching the family of an adult
who sleepwalks about home safety. Which
measures should the nurse include? Select
all that apply.
What fits here
Keep floors clear of clutter and cords ·
Lock exterior doors and windows at night ·
Arrange for the client to sleep in a
ground floor bedroom when possible · Place
an alarm or chime on the…
Why it fits
Clearing hazards, securing exits, sleeping
on one level, and alerting the family to
movement all reduce the chance of injury
during an episode. Waking the client
abruptly causes disorientation and
agitation, and an open stairway is exactly
the hazard the family is trying to remove.
